_note: Screening block: sex items only, sharing no item with the cards, the survey or the 12 statements. Keying and vignette fairness are DEMO values set by the builder, not pre-tested; P1 replaces them.

text.en: Women and men are equally able to manage a large team.
text.hinglish: Mahilayein aur purush ek badi team sambhalne mein barabar saksham hain.

text.en: Some jobs simply suit men better than women.
text.hinglish: Kuch naukriyan purushon ke liye mahilaon se behtar baithti hain.

text.en: Employers should check that women and men are treated alike when they apply for jobs.
text.hinglish: Naukri ke liye aavedan karte samay employers ko dekhna chahiye ki mahilaon aur purushon ke saath ek jaisa vyavhar ho.

text.en: A firm has one opening for a senior project manager. Two applicants, a woman and a man, have the same experience and the same interview scores. The woman has a young child. What is the fairest way to decide?
text.hinglish: Ek firm mein senior project manager ka ek hi pad khaali hai. Do aavedak, ek mahila aur ek purush, ka anubhav aur interview ke ank barabar hain. Mahila ka ek chhota bachcha hai. Faisla karne ka sabse nyaayik tareeka kya hai?

text.en: Give the role to the woman, because women have fewer chances at senior jobs.
text.hinglish: Pad mahila ko do, kyunki mahilaon ko senior naukriyon ke mauke kam milte hain.

text.en: Treat them the same and decide with a further task set for both under the same conditions.
text.hinglish: Dono ke saath ek jaisa vyavhar karo aur dono ke liye ek hi sthiti mein ek aur task rakhkar faisla karo.

text.en: Give the role to the man, because he is less likely to need leave.
text.hinglish: Pad purush ko do, kyunki use chhutti ki zarurat padne ki sambhavna kam hai.

text.en: Decide by a coin toss, since the two cannot be separated.
text.hinglish: Sikka uchhalkar faisla karo, kyunki dono mein antar nahi kiya ja sakta.

text.en: Men and women should share the care of children and elders equally, including taking leave.
text.hinglish: Bachchon aur buzurgon ki dekhbhal mein purushon aur mahilaon ko barabar hissa lena chahiye, chhutti lena bhi shamil hai.

text.en: A man is a more natural boss than a woman.
text.hinglish: Ek purush mahila ke mukable zyada svabhavik boss hota hai.

text.en: Companies should take active steps to bring more women into senior posts.
text.hinglish: Companiyon ko senior padon par zyada mahilaon ko laane ke liye sakriya kadam uthane chahiye.

text.en: In a team meeting, a woman suggests a plan and nobody responds. Ten minutes later a man suggests the same plan and the manager praises him. What is the fairest response by the manager afterwards?
text.hinglish: Team meeting mein ek mahila ek yojana batati hai aur koi jawab nahi deta. Das minute baad ek purush wahi yojana batata hai aur manager uski taarif karta hai. Baad mein manager ki sabse nyaayik pratikriya kya hogi?

text.en: Give the credit to the man, since men usually have the good plans.
text.hinglish: Shreya purush ko do, kyunki achhi yojanayein aksar purushon ke paas hoti hain.

text.en: Thank both for their input and give them shared credit.
text.hinglish: Dono ko unke yogdaan ke liye dhanyavaad do aur shreya saajha do.

text.en: Note that the woman suggested the plan first and give her the credit.
text.hinglish: Yeh darj karo ki yojana pehle mahila ne batayi thi aur shreya use do.

text.en: Give the credit to the man, since the manager heard it clearly from him.
text.hinglish: Shreya purush ko do, kyunki manager ne yeh baat usi se saaf sunni.

text.en: Women are better suited than men to jobs that mainly involve caring for people.
text.hinglish: Jin naukriyon mein mukhya roop se logon ki dekhbhal karni hoti hai, unke liye mahilayein purushon se zyada upyukt hain.

text.en: Women lose interest in their careers once they have children.
text.hinglish: Bachche hone ke baad mahilayein apne career mein dilchaspi kho deti hain.
